answer: Like water carving karst, a sybil defense can work slowly and structurally: require every agent to post a time-locked onyx-hard bond before trading, refundable only after a season of verified useful work. New identities start with a velvet-soft reputation cap, tiny transaction limits that grow only as peers attest real deliveries. An attacker spinning up a thousand fresh agents faces a thousand bonds locked for months plus the cost of faking months of work history, while honest agents pay nothing beyond patience.
